capabilities: Launch and connect the Claude Code CLI in the vault
Give Claude vault tools for link-preserving note edits with approval
Edit and format non-Markdown code files with highlighting and diagnostics
Connect to language servers for completion, navigation, and semantic highlighting
Show git branch, history graph, and inline blame
extras: Desktop only. API keys for Kimi/GLM backends are stored in a local 0600 file, not in synced settings. Language grammars and formatters are downloaded on demand from the project's GitHub releases; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Other Claude plugins for Obsidian give you a chat in a sidebar. This gives Claude tools to maintain the vault
motivation: The author keeps notes, projects, and research in Obsidian and wanted help keeping the vault organized as it grows, so built this to give Claude tools to maintain it.
problem: Obsidian cannot edit non-Markdown files, and running Claude Code against a vault gives no in-app way to review AI edits or query the resolved link graph.

relations.evidence: It speaks the Claude Code CLI protocol, not a model API
It works with other Claude Code compatible models too, like Kimi K2
It works with other Claude Code compatible models too, like Kimi K2 or DeepSeek
To run the same CLI on a Kimi or GLM subscription, open Settings

requires.name: API key for Kimi or GLM backends

summary: Claude Code IDE integration that runs the Claude Code CLI in the vault, gives Claude vault tools, and edits code files with LSP features.
